-- hand over hand
open first
open gen3
hand over first -> gen3
close first
open gen2
hand over gen3 -> gen2
close gen3
open gen1
hand over gen2 -> gen1
close gen2
close gen1
rolled out
-- early exit
open step
close step
failed
open step
stepped with step
close step
stepped
-- tasks and attach
open old
a closed; old stays open for b
task of b uses old
close old
-- cancellation
q cancelled: true, p cancelled: false
opened in a cancelled parent: true
worker stopped: the scope ended
child task: cancelled
-- returned owner
a task of the returned scope
-- parent closes children first
open base
open child
child task uses base and child
close child
close base
failed
app ends
